title: Pride Flag Trails
description: Adds a menu to show cosmetic particle trails behind your character in the colors of Pride Flags!
body:
Press the Quick Actions Keybind (default: G) or open the menu from the pause screen to access the Pride Trail Selection Menu. From there you can select a pride flag and a style and have the trail display behind you!
Currently available flags include:
- Rainbow
- Lesbian
- Gay
- Transgender
- Genderfluid
- Nonbinary
- Agender
- Asexual
- Aromantic
- AroAce
- Bigender
- Bisexual
- Pansexual
